meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜、配音和字幕合成为可发布的视频成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常做视频合成剪辑,需要批量渲染并发布到不同平台。
copy.tagline_en: Turn storyboards, voiceover and subtitles into publishable video renders.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you produce video content and need to render and publish it in batches.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你搭视频项目、从 catalog 找现成动画、检查报错、打开 Studio 预览，最后按你选的质量渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你要用 HyperFrames 新建或编辑视频项目、渲染成片，或排查构建与渲染失败时，它会接管这套 CLI 流程。

say.text: 把这个网站抓下来，做成一个 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 会先捕获站点再生成工程

say.text: 帮我找 catalog 里逐行显示标题的动画
say.note: 在本地 catalog 搜索，命中后可 add 安装

say.text: 检查项目有没有报错，然后渲染成 out.mp4
say.note: 先跑 check，再按 looks 质量渲染

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI for you: it scaffolds a video project, finds catalog animation moves, adds them, lints and checks the build, opens a Studio preview, and renders to a video file at the quality you pick.
howto.when_en: Use it when you build or edit a HyperFrames video project, render a video, or diagnose build and render failures.

say_en.text: Capture this site and turn it into a HyperFrames project
say_en.note: Captures the site, then scaffolds the project

say_en.text: Find a catalog animation that reveals a headline line by line
say_en.note: Runs a local catalog search; add installs a hit

say_en.text: Check the project for errors, then render out.mp4
say_en.note: Runs check first, then a looks-quality render
